"""Freeze fixed V160 scoring/native figures before observing quality."""
import ast
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
previous=Path(plan['previous']);old=previous/'postprocess-v1/scripts'
post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py',
             'profile_raw_kernel_inference.py','report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:
    shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/review_paired_response_trial.py',post/'review_paired_response_trial.py')
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
    s=(old/f'{name}_regional_dc_transition_trial.py').read_text().replace('_regional_dc_transition_trial','_paired_response_trial')
    s=s.replace('V159 regional-DC-transition regret and exact spatial-RGB control','V160 ordinary and paired-response')
    if name=='score':
        needle='assert read(review["plan"]["path"])["design"] == ref(design_path)'
        assert needle in s
        s=s.replace(needle,'assert review["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")\n    assert read(root / "postprocess-plan-v1.json")["design"] == ref(design_path)')
    if name=='render':
        needle='names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","V158 sharp raw1k","V158 sharp EMA1k","Smooth DC raw1k","Smooth DC EMA1k"]'
        assert s.count(needle)==1
        s=s.replace(needle,'names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Ordinary raw1k","Ordinary EMA1k","Pair response raw1k","Pair response EMA1k"]')
        s=s.replace('47078400','50764800')
        s=s.replace('add4 retained V156 detail/V157 coarse raw/EMA columns','add5 retained V156 detail/V157 coarse/V158 quiet/V159 compromise columns')
        s=s.replace('4 fixed V159 endpoints','4 fixed V160 endpoints')
    ast.parse(s);(post/f'{name}_paired_response_trial.py').write_text(s)
priorretained=read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections']
v158=read(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V158-regional-dc-v1/review-result-v1.json')['collections']
v159=read(previous/'review-result-v1.json')['collections']
retained={'V156 raw retained':priorretained['V156 raw retained'],
    'V157 EMA retained':priorretained['V157 EMA retained'],
    'V158 EMA retained':v158['dc-regret-EMA-step1000'],
    'V159 raw retained':v159['smooth-dc-raw-step1000'],
    'V159 EMA retained':v159['smooth-dc-EMA-step1000']}
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
for binding in retained.values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path'])
    assert [o['id'] for o in collection['observations']]==[c['id'] for c in cases]
    assert all(o['parent']==c['parent'] for o,c in zip(collection['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,
    'scope':'Fixed before quality:V156 raw detail,V157 EMA coarse,V158 EMA quiet,V159 raw/EMA compromise. Five native columns,identical822 input/parent bindings;no additional forwards.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103'
metric_paths=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',
              shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
cmd='from pathlib import Path;from score_paired_response_trial import load_module;'
cmd+=f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
cmd+='import audit_paired_response_trial,render_paired_response_trial,review_paired_response_trial;print("PASS actual primary/independent metrics,review and render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',cmd],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':cmd,
    'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metric_paths],'retained_native_collections':retained,
    'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},'new_neural_forwards':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(run.stdout.strip());print('Frozen9 postprocess sources,five retained comparator columns')
